research.title: Evaluating Segmentation Robustness Under Image Corruptions
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare semantic segmentation models under simulated blur, sensor noise, and illumination changes using matched evaluation images.
Implemented corruption pipelines and examined classwise overlap scores and boundary errors to characterize model sensitivity across degradation types.

research.title: Background Sensitivity in Leaf Disease Image Classification
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance to test how background masking and crop selection affect leaf disease classification across acquisition conditions.
Compared convolutional classifiers using controlled preprocessing ablations, stratified data splits, and confusion analysis to examine disease recognition errors associated with background variation.

publications.title: Evaluating Background Masking and Crop Selection for Leaf Disease Image Classification

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Documentation
bullets: Checked incoming delivery paperwork against order records, filed receipts, and referred missing items or inconsistent quantities to the responsible staff.
Maintained stockroom labels and routine inventory logs, prepared packing materials, and organized order documents for daily handoffs between staff.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Planar Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented corner detection, patch descriptors, and robust homography estimation to align image pairs depicting planar scenes under viewpoint changes.
Compared descriptor normalization and matching thresholds using correspondence precision, reprojection error, and visual inspection of alignment failures.

projects.title: Classical and Convolutional Approaches to Texture Classification
bullets: Implemented local binary pattern and filter bank baselines alongside a compact convolutional classifier for texture recognition using consistent training splits.
Compared classification errors under rotation and illumination transformations, examining which texture categories were sensitive to each representation.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Denoising Methods
bullets: Implemented median filtering, bilateral filtering, and a convolutional denoising baseline for images corrupted with impulse noise and additive Gaussian noise.
Evaluated reconstruction quality using peak signal to noise ratio and structural similarity, inspecting edge preservation and smoothing artifacts across noise settings.
